jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description:
About Flyra

Flyra is stablecoin infrastructure for businesses in markets the traditional banking system underserves. Through one API, payment service providers embed wallets, yield, Visa cards, settlement, and credit for their business customers.

Flyra also gives partners a data platform: a continuously reconciled, real-time view of every balance, liability, and transaction across on-chain and off-chain accounts. Vedax, our AI layer, works on that data to investigate transactions, monitor reserves, and turn payments data into insights and credit decisions.

We're in production, backed by Coinbase Ventures, Digital Currency Group, Rally Cap, and Goodwater, and led by a founder who was CFO at Kabbage and Flutterwave.

The role

You'll own Flyra's technology end to end: architecture, security, and reliability. You'll partner with a strong, senior engineering team in India that shipped our business platform (KYB, auth, web app) in one week, and help them carry that speed into a regulated money business.

What you'll do

Own the API and integrations that partners build on
Scale the data platform and Vedax as products partners rely on daily
Build the ledger, reconciliation, and controls that banks and regulators trust
Lead the move to owned rails: sponsor bank integration, money transmission, and off-ramp acquisitions
Grow the engineering org across India and the US, building on the team that built the platform
Work alongside commercial and compliance leadership on every partner launch

What you bring

10+ years building payments, banking, or ledger systems, including senior leadership of a distributed team
Regulated money movement shipped to production: card issuing, KYC/KYB, BaaS or sponsor bank integrations
Data platform or applied AI experience in a financial context
Stablecoin or on-chain settlement experience, or a strong appetite to go deep
Hands-on: you design systems and review code
Emerging markets experience (Africa, LatAm) is a plus

Why Flyra

Founding executive role with meaningful equity
Live product with real volume
A small team where your decisions ship the same week

Seniority level

Executive

Employment type

Full-time

Industries
